description: Manage binary packages for FreeBSD using pkgng which is available in versions after 9.0.

parameters.name: annotation
parameters.description: A list of keyvalue-pairs of the form <+/-/:><key>[=<value>]. A + denotes adding an annotation, a - denotes removing an annotation, and : denotes modifying an annotation. If setting or modifying annotations, a value must be provided.

parameters.name: autoremove
parameters.description: Remove automatically installed packages which are no longer needed. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: cached
parameters.description: Use local package base instead of fetching an updated one. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: chroot
parameters.description: Pkg chroots in the specified environment. Can not be used together with rootdir or jail options.

parameters.name: ignore_osver
parameters.description: Ignore FreeBSD OS version check, useful on -STABLE and -CURRENT branches. Defines the IGNORE_OSVERSION environment variable. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: jail
parameters.description: Pkg executes in the given jail name or ID. Can not be used together with chroot or rootdir options.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name or list of names of packages to install/remove. With name=*, state=latest operates, but state=present and state=absent are noops.

parameters.name: pkgsite
parameters.description: For pkgng versions before 1.1.4, specify packagesite to use for downloading packages. If not specified, use settings from /usr/local/etc/pkg.conf. For newer pkgng versions, specify a the name of a repository configured in /usr/local/etc/pkg/repos.

parameters.name: rootdir
parameters.description: For pkgng versions 1.5 and later, pkg installs all packages within the specified root directory. Can not be used together with chroot or jail options.

parameters.name: use_globs
parameters.description: Treat the package names as shell glob patterns. Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
- name: Install package foo
  community.general.pkgng:
    name: foo
    state: present

- name: Annotate package foo and bar
  community.general.pkgng:
    name:
      - foo
      - bar
    annotation: '+test1=baz,-test2,:test3=foobar'

- name: Remove packages foo and bar
  community.general.pkgng:
    name:
      - foo
      - bar
    state: absent

- name: Upgrade package baz
  community.general.pkgng:
    name: baz
    state: latest

- name: Upgrade all installed packages (see warning for the name option first!)
  community.general.pkgng:
    name: "*"
    state: latest

- name: Upgrade foo/bar
  community.general.pkgng:
    name: foo/bar
    state: latest
    use_globs: false
